Decompose and parallel subtasks where ever possible.

Independent subtasks:
SubTask 1: Open the box. (Skills Required: GoToObject, OpenObject)
SubTask 2: Break the mug. (Skills Required: GoToObject, BreakObject)
SubTask 3: Put the mug on the shelf. (Skills Required: GoToObject, PickupObject, PutObject)

We can parallelize SubTask 1 and SubTask 2 because they don't depend on each other. SubTask 3 depends on SubTask 2 being completed (the mug must be broken first, but the mug can be picked up and moved regardless of its broken state). However, SubTask 3 can be executed after SubTask 2 is completed.
